abstract_sentences.text: We study reinforcement learning with delayed state observation, where the agent observes the current state after some random number of time steps.

evidence.anchor: We study reinforcement learning with delayed state observation.

abstract_sentences.text: We propose an algorithm that combines the augmentation method and the upper confidence bound approach.

evidence.anchor: We propose an algorithm that combines.

abstract_sentences.text: For tabular Markov decision processes (MDPs), we derive a regret bound of tilde-O(H sqrt(D_max S A K)).
We also provide a matching lower bound up to logarithmic factors, showing the optimality of our approach.

evidence.anchor: matching lower bound up to logarithmic factors

abstract_sentences.text: Our analytical framework formulates this problem as a special case of a broader class of MDPs, where their transition dynamics decompose into a known component and an unknown but structured component.

evidence.anchor: known component and an unknown but structured component

abstract_sentences.text: We establish general results for this abstract setting, which may be of independent interest.

final_judgment.single_storyline: Augment delayed observations into an MDP whose unknown transition part is shareable, obtain upper bounds with UCB optimism, and match them with a CodeMDP lower bound.
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: Model, three augmented-state categories, informal algorithms, five named theorems, a computational barrier, and the partially-known-dynamics abstraction remain in the main body.
final_judgment.appendix_moves: Full update order, concentration/optimism/cumulative-regret derivations, CodeMDP hard-instance construction, fuzzy-hypothesis lower bound, and auxiliary inequalities move to Appendices A--G.
final_judgment.best_pattern: Use small diagrams and trajectory tables to make the state augmentation legible, then state the tight upper/lower result before relegating technical proof chains.
final_judgment.largest_gap: The practical computation cost is exponential in D_max, and no empirical non-tabular or implementation evidence tests the conclusion beyond the stated theoretical structure.
final_judgment.transfer_rule: When a large observable state representation has a small shared uncertainty owner, expose the known/unknown decomposition in the main text and place reusable proof machinery in an appendix.
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: The pattern requires a real shared feature map and is insufficient when deployment, implementation, or empirical behavior is the decision-bearing evidence.
